name: bizplug-activity-calendar
description: The activity calendar plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: activities by date, with places per person. It works from the business's own published profile, covering the activities on offer, their dates and prices, who they suit, what to bring and where to meet, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Never say a place is booked or held: the organiser confirms every request. Never take payment or card details in the chat. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
